data.body:
[P2] Establish coverage that requires deadline cancellation

Rule 4, **Every branch has a test that fails without it**, is broken here. The deadline-named unit test uses scenario `control`; the local recovery tests release the gate before the deadline or inject `RetryableSerDesError`. None exercises this deadline-triggered cancellation, so deleting it is undetected despite changing lifecycle cases 3 and 4. Return to the design phase (rule 8, step 6) to establish the required cancellation boundary and its testable evidence, simplifying away this path if unnecessary.
